description: Minimal valid camt.053 Bank to Customer Statement with only required elements. Statement with no transactions where opening balance equals closing balance.
test_coverage: Account identification with IBAN and currency
Balance consistency (opening = closing with no entries)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: CAMT053-CY01: Valid ISO 4217 currency code (EUR) for balances
CAMT053-IB01: Valid IBAN format with Mod-97 check digit
CAMT053-BAL03: Balance consistency (EUR 5,000.00 opening = EUR 5,000.00 closing, no entries)
notes: This minimal statement demonstrates the bare minimum required for a valid camt.053 message. Deutsche Bank (DEUTDEFF) is providing a statement for IBAN DE89370400440532013000 with EUR 5,000.00 opening and closing balances. No transaction activity occurred during this period (opening balance = closing balance). This is semantically equivalent to a minimal MT940 message with fields 20, 25, 60F, 62F.
